A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CLIBD study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v4 reports original classification and retrieval experiments on BIOSCAN-1M and INSECT, together with ablations, visual analyses and training-resource measurements.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experiments and adds DNA embedding ablation results in Appendix C.5, Tables 21–22.

M1.justification: The proposed encoders, contrastive objective and retrieval procedures remain unchanged. Appendix C.5 identifies FFN+softmax+mean as the configuration used for the main experiments and evaluates alternatives; it documents the existing implementation without establishing a replacement of the main method.

E1.justification: BIOSCAN-1M and INSECT coverage, taxonomic classification tasks and retrieval scenarios are retained. The new pooling experiments reuse the BIOSCAN-1M test set and existing query/key combinations, adding no dataset, population or task scenario.

E2.justification: Tables 21–22 add three internal comparison variants against the main FFN+softmax+mean configuration: hidden-state mean pooling, CLS-token pooling and FFN+mean. Existing comparisons with SimCLR, BioCLIP, BZSL and other encoders are unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 5 changes the stated main training duration from 50 to 30 epochs, retaining the batch size, hardware and optimizer settings. Appendix C.5 adds comparisons across DNA output configurations under existing evaluation metrics. The PDFs do not establish whether the epoch revision reflects rerunning experiments or correcting their description.

E4.justification: New Appendix C.5 tests how four DNA embedding constructions affect DNA-to-DNA, image-to-image and image-to-DNA retrieval across taxonomic levels. This adds a focused component ablation; the existing temperature, precision, LoRA, batch-size and supplementary analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Appendix B.1 and Figure 9 retain the four-random-seed analysis and existing uncertainty reporting. The new pooling tables do not introduce additional run-count disclosures, uncertainty estimates or statistical tests.

E6.justification: Tables 21–22 add pooling-specific results. For example, Table 21 reports species image-to-image macro harmonic means of 52.5% for hidden-state mean pooling and 51.2% for the default. Retained tables keep their scores. Some newly reported default micro scores differ from retained Table 8: species DNA-to-DNA harmonic mean is 97.1% versus 97.3%, without an explanation of whether runs differ.

T1.justification: The contrastive-loss equations and inference definitions are unchanged. The new pooling diagrams and tensor-shape descriptions explain implementation rather than introducing formal assumptions, theoretical results or mathematical derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: aligning images, DNA barcodes and taxonomic text, improving classification representations, and enabling cross-modal retrieval. The added pooling analysis does not redefine or strengthen these core claims.

C2.justification: Existing interpretations and Appendix D limitations concerning barcode reliability, laboratory imagery and real-world deployment are retained. Appendix C.5 summarizes measured pooling rankings but adds no separate causal explanation or revised applicability boundary.

D1.justification: Section 3.1 and Appendix C.5 newly specify image CLS-token extraction, text mean pooling and projection, and the DNA prediction-head modification from 1027 to 768 outputs. They explicitly identify FFN+softmax+mean as the main configuration. These additions improve implementation disclosure; access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 81 cited works and research positioning are retained. Changes to the BioCLIP reference concern author-name and bibliographic formatting, not a different cited work or relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v5 adds a short embedding-construction paragraph, Appendix C.5 and an expanded Appendix C overview. It locally reorganizes appendix text around the attention figures, makes small wording edits and removes the conference-publication header. The overall narrative and section hierarchy remain stable.

P2.justification: v5 adds the pooling schematic as Figure 14 and results Tables 21–22. The previous modalities overview becomes Figure 15, with small label edits and relocation beside Appendix D. Existing appendix figures and tables are locally repositioned, and Table 9 gains two missing not-applicable dashes.

improvement.justification: Appendix C.5 clarifies previously unspecified embedding construction and supplies useful evidence about pooling sensitivity, improving reproducibility and empirical understanding. These are limited gains to otherwise stable work. Their value is tempered by the unexplained 50-to-30-epoch revision and discrepancies between the default micro scores in Tables 22 and 8.
